To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the energy-aware mobile app is a useful tool to increase user-awarenes on energy consumption and to reduce the energy consumption of a smart home.

the design of an energy-aware mobile app should: 1) be simple and easy to use, 2) provide a clear overview of energy consumption, 3) allow to compare the energy consumption of the different devices in the house, 4) allow to compare with other households and 5) provide information on how to reduce energy consumption.
the design and development of an energy-aware mobile app for Smart Home monitoring can be improved by using participatory design methods.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a mobile application to increase user-awarement on energy consumption.
the development of tools and methodologies to support the development of user-centred energy-awareness mobile applications for smart home monitoring.
developing a mobile application to increase user-aware awareness on energy consumption.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the participatory approach we followed in our research allowed on designing and implementing an energy-aware application that is usable, useful and acceptable to end-users.
our participatory approach has been successful in identifying user needs, which in turn led to a better design of an energy-aware mobile app.
the proposed approach and the resulting mobile app are a good solution for user-awareness in energy consumption.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
participatory design approach can be used as an alternative to the traditional approach to design and develop user-awareness tools.
participatory design is an effective approach for developing energy-aware applications that increase userawareness and engagement on energy consumption.
the design process for energy-awareness applications should be user-centered.
The main takeaway from our work is that
user-awareness is a key factor in the design of energy-aware tools and applications.
participatory design approach is a key factor in the design of user-awareness systems.
user-awareness on environmental impact can be increased by using mobile apps that are designed in a user-centered manner.
